target_customer: DevOps and platform engineering teams that manage cloud infrastructure with Terraform, OpenTofu or CDK-TF
problem: Infrastructure as Code changes are hard to review, and a bad merge can cause drift, outages or cost spikes; reviewers need context beyond the diff.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with a 14 day free trial
product_category: AI code review for Infrastructure as Code

founders.name: Carlos Feliciano
founders.background_notes: YC page says over a decade in infrastructure, monitoring and operations at YC-backed startups and large enterprises and calls him an AWS Solutions Architect; no employers or school named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs to combine code, plan output, remote state and live cloud resources to judge a change, with LLM context handling; standard engineering with some hard parts for a tiny team.

defensibility.rationale: Review prompts and integrations are copyable; infrastructure vendors and general AI code reviewers can add the same feature.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: HashiCorp lists Terracotta AI as a Premier tier technology partner; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Terraform pull request review was a manual, high risk step, and Atlantis style plan-on-PR tooling was already common, which shows demand for automation around IaC changes. No dated 2023 spend data was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses tryterracotta.com (try prefix), not terracotta.com; blog at blog.tryterracotta.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, risk reduction framing such as ticking time bombs in IaC deployments.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community signal found about the brand; the name collides with Terracotta.org and the similar Terrakotta (another YC company) in search.

outcome_analysis: Terracotta AI is an active three person company selling AI review of Terraform pull requests. It has a HashiCorp partnership listing and named customers on its YC page, but no verified funding, revenue or traction numbers were found. The category is crowded with IaC platforms and general AI code reviewers, so the outcome is still open and nothing here supports a success or failure story yet.
